Lab 4 in nine animated steps

Each animation shows one step of the set-up and of Part E, on the real pages and outputs of Class 14 (steps 1, 4–7) or on a simplified illustration (steps 2, 3, 8, 9). Every GIF (Graphics Interchange Format) can be downloaded. The full instructions and the grading are in the Lab 4 document.

Due Saturday, November 28, 2026, at midnight (23:59, Eastern Time, Montréal) — Léa drop box of Omnivox.

1Download the code package

Open the Class 14 lecture page, go to any code example and press Code package (ZIP [compressed archive file format]). Save kalmia_c14_code.zip and unzip it into C:\labs\kalmia_c14_code (Windows) or ~/labs/kalmia_c14_code (macOS, Linux).

⚠ Your browser shows downloads in its own way (footnote 4).

2Verify the download (SHA-256 [Secure Hash Algorithm with a 256-bit result])

Before opening a downloaded file, compare its SHA-256 (Secure Hash Algorithm with a 256-bit result) value with the published one (Legal Notice v2.0, s. 14 and Annex C). Value of this package: 7ea26f69cb436fb5d32e24096a040976dbb88ec5a8d3b1b5bbb87deecb2bebb6. Windows: certutil -hashfile kalmia_c14_code.zip SHA256 · macOS: shasum -a 256 kalmia_c14_code.zip · Linux: sha256sum kalmia_c14_code.zip.

3Install Python 3.15

On Windows, install the Python install manager from python.org or the Microsoft Store, then run py install 3.15 and check py -V. On macOS use the python.org installer; on Linux, your distribution's package (python3 --version). Python 3.14 also works.

⚠ The install manager's messages may differ in newer versions (footnote 1).

4Run example 1 → Part E1

In the kalmia_c14_code folder run py kalmia_hardening_audit.py (macOS/Linux: python3 …). Compare with the expected values, then open kalmia_out/kalmia_hardening_report.csv. Examples 2 and 6 run the same way: py kalmia_access_review.py and py kalmia_introduced_risks.py.

5Run example 3 in Bash → Part E3

Windows: open Git Bash (Git for Windows 2.56.1) or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) in the folder; macOS and Linux: Terminal. Run bash kalmia_segmentation_test.sh. Then add two flows of your own to kalmia_data/kalmia_test_flows.txt and run it again.

⚠ Git for Windows 2.56 changed some internal paths; window titles and prompts may look different (footnote 2).

6Example 4 in the browser → Part E4

Double-click kalmia_awareness_module.html. Click every part of a message that is a warning sign, press Check, read the explanations, then press Export plan (CSV [comma-separated values]) at the bottom.

7Example 5 in the browser → Part E5

Open kalmia_defence_in_depth.html. Record the four scenarios: After the plan, Today, Today with the common cause, After with the common cause. Copy the probability, the strong layers and the verdict into sheet E5.

8The workbook → Parts E and F

Open Lab4_PartE_Starter_Kalmia.xlsx with LibreOffice 26.8 or Excel. Fill only the yellow cells. In F_Budget, type Y or N for each new control and watch the remaining budget: with every control funded, the plan is $3,710 over budget.

⚠ LibreOffice menus and colours may differ between versions (footnote 3).

9Submit on Léa

Put the plan (PDF [Portable Document Format]), the workbook and the outputs/ folder into Lab4_TeamName.zip. In Omnivox, open Léa → 420-1C2-DW → Assignments, choose Lab 4, add the ZIP (compressed archive file format) and press Submit. Deadline: Saturday, November 28, 2026, at midnight (23:59, Eastern Time).

⚠ Simplified illustration: the real Omnivox screens, labels and language differ (footnote 5).

Footnotes — what may look different in a newer version

  1. Python: the Python install manager became the recommended installer on Windows with Python 3.14; its commands (py install, py -V) and messages can change in later versions. Checked on November 18, 2026: Python 3.15.2 (October 25, 2026).
  2. Git for Windows 2.56.1 (November 2026 security release); version 2.56.0 replaced the internal /mingw64 paths with /ucrt64 and dropped Windows 8.1. Prompts and window titles may look different on your computer.
  3. LibreOffice 26.8 (August 2026). Menus, colours and the position of the sheet tabs may change in later versions; Microsoft Excel and OnlyOffice open the same workbook.
  4. Chrome, Edge and Firefox show downloads differently (a bar, a panel or an icon). The file is in your Downloads folder unless you chose another one.
  5. The submission screens are a simplified illustration, not a copy of Omnivox: the real labels (English or French), the colours and the order of the menus differ. If you cannot find the drop box, use the course page in Léa or ask the teacher before the deadline.
